# Plan review negative control fixtures (decision 170)

`bad/` plants three faults a counting Goldfish review must name, by scope: **T2** creates `src/retry.mjs` although
`src/util/retry.mjs` already exists (zoom-out, reuse-search); **T3** leaves the storage format to the builder
(readiness, zero-decision); **D3** has reversibility `hard` and no alternative (critic, alternatives).
`good/` is the same repo with the plan reusing the util, every choice recorded, and D3 with an alternative.
Each fixture is `repo/` (committed once by the runner at review time), `plan.json`, `spec.md` and `checks/`.
